work.author: Francis
work.description: The apostolic constitution of 19 January 2015 by which Francis detached the eparchies of Asmara, Barentu, Keren, and Segheneity from the metropolitan archieparchy of Addis Ababa and erected the Eritrean Metropolitan Church sui iuris, raising Asmara to a metropolitan archieparchy.
work.title: In Erythraea nova constituitur Ecclesia Metropolitana Asmarensis
